prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Medium shot. A man in silhouette at the front of a crowd, his face hidden in shadow, one hand raised in a dismissive wave toward a giant long rectangular wooden crate of rough planks smeared pitch-black, with a flat plank roof and flat square ends, as tall at both ends as in the middle, resting flat on the hill behind him, the roof empty and flat, the crowd around him seen from behind, faces turned away toward the crate. Evening, warm firelight from the tents. Careless and proud. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No text, no logos.
